goal: Is ke baad aap samjha sakein ge ke translators ki zaroorat kyun hai, compiler, interpreter aur assembler ka muqabla kar sakein ge, source, object aur machine code bayan kar sakein ge, aur syntax, runtime aur logical errors mein farq bata sakein ge.
warmup: Sochein ke aap sirf Urdu bolte hain aur aap ko ek aise driver ko raasta batana hai jo sirf Chinese samajhta hai. Aap ko ek translator chahiye. Computer ka CPU sirf machine language (0 aur 1) samajhta hai. Aap ka C++ insaanon ke liye likha gaya hai. Is liye beech mein ek translator program chahiye.
definition: Language translator ek program hai jo ek language mein likhe code ko machine language mein badal deta hai. Iski teen qismein hain. Compiler poore high-level program ko ek saath translate karta hai aur executable file banata hai. Interpreter program ko ek waqt mein ek line translate karke chalata hai. Assembler assembly language ko machine code mein badalta hai. Source code woh program hai jo aap likhte hain (.cpp). Object code aap ki sirf us file ka compiler ka machine-code output hai (.obj ya .o). Machine code ya executable linking ke baad ka final code hai (.exe) jo CPU chala sakta hai.
howItWorks: C++ ek compiled language hai. Raasta yeh hai: program.cpp (source code) preprocessor se guzarta hai (jo #include files add karta hai), phir compiler usay object code (program.obj) mein translate karta hai, phir linker object code ko library code (misal ke taur par cout ke peeche ka code) ke saath jod kar program.exe banata hai, aur akhir mein loader usay RAM mein rakhta hai aur CPU chalata hai. Compiler poora program parhne ke baad saari syntax errors batata hai. Interpreter (Python, JavaScript) pehli error par ruk jata hai aur koi .exe nahi banata, aur har dafa dobara translate karta hai, is liye aam taur par slow hota hai. Errors ki teen qismein hain: syntax error language ka rule todta hai aur compile time par pakdi jati hai; runtime error program chalte waqt hoti hai (misal ke taur par zero se divide karna); logical error mein program chal jata hai lekin jawab ghalat deta hai.
